newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended mostly firmer which also boded well for the Swiss federal govenment's bond tender announced Tuesday morning, traders said.
The tender reopens the outstanding 4-1/2 percent June 2007 bond, allowing for an allocation of up to one billion Swiss francs SWIV. Final terms of the tender will be announced on Thursday.

"We held up well at the start, despite the fact we had a tender," one trader said. Traders believed the allocation for the new tranche may be for at least 500 million Swiss francs, and possibly for up to 700 or 800 million francs.
Traders said that the outstanding amount could then be raised from the current roughly 1.5 billion francs to 2.0 billion or more.

Prices in the short end were also firmer. Traders in London said the market may have improved after news Switzerland's Centre of Economic Activity (KOF) said it had revised its autumn economic forecast for Swiss growth in 1997 down to zero from a previous estimate of growth of 0.9 percent nD2000118.
Mar Conf futures CONFH6 up 16 at 117.04.
Mar Comi medium-term bond COMIH7 down 20 at 111.30.
Mar Euro Swiss francs FESH7 up eight at 98.16.
